summary: MVP validation of Digital Chai & Coffee Lounge. Backend WebSocket at /api/ws/{room_name} was tested with 11 pytest cases covering welcome, join+roster, chat broadcast (incl. sender), empty-chat suppression, all 4 valid actions, invalid-action ignore, and a two-client scenario for chat/action forwarding and roster update on disconnect. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend was tested via Playwright: avatar setup modal (name, drink, head switching human<->cat with hair/fur toggle), join flow, canvas render, control-bar actions (drink/cheers/steam/wave), chat send/receive, and a two-session multi-user flow (?demo=1 + manual join) confirming cross-session chat sync and guest count of 2. No console/page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: broadcast() iterates room.members and sends to sender too (correct per spec). No auth/rate-limit on chat (acceptable for ephemeral MVP but flag for future).
Lounge.jsx line 34: npcs.forEach(rememberDrink) runs on every render (side effect during render). Move into useMemo/useEffect to avoid needless writes.
useLounge WS URL derives ws scheme via string replace - works but consider new URL() for safer parsing.
test_credentials: None (no auth). Use ?demo=1 to auto-join as 'Bo'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend WS tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_lounge_ws.py. Run: pytest backend/tests/test_lounge_ws.py -v. WS URL is BASE_URL.replace(https,wss)+/api/ws/lounge. Multi-user chat sync verified against public URL.
